requirements.text: The central trading system (CTS) is to complete the trading of stock.
requirements.source_sentence: The central trading system (CTS) is to complete the trading of stock.
requirements.section: 1.1 Goals and objectives

requirements.text: It analyses the instructions that enter the central trading system and divides them into several kinds of instructions.
actions: analyse the instructions that enter the central trading system
divide them into several kinds of instructions
requirements.source_sentence: It analyses the instructions that enter the central trading system and divides them into several kinds of instructions.
requirements.section: 1.1 Goals and objectives

requirements.text: System will make a match between them under specifically prescripts.
actions: make a match between them under specifically prescripts
requirements.source_sentence: System will make a match between them under specifically prescripts.

requirements.text: Also central trading system provides some interfaces to send messages to other modules.

requirements.source_sentence: Also central trading system provides some interfaces to send messages to other modules.
requirements.section: 1.1 Goals and objectives

requirements.text: The CTS is just a subsystem of the whole stock trading system (STS) system.
requirements.source_sentence: The CTS is just a subsystem of the whole stock trading system (STS) system.
requirements.section: 1.2 System Context

requirements.text: There are mainly six subsystems involved, stock account operation, financing account operation, trade client serve, network message promulgating, central trading system and trading system manage.
requirements.source_sentence: There are mainly six subsystems involved, stock account operation, financing account operation, trade client serve, network message promulgating, central trading system and trading system manage.
requirements.section: 1.2 System Context

requirements.text: Communications exist among these subsystems which complicates the relationships between subsystems.
requirements.source_sentence: Communications exist among these subsystems which complicates the relationships between subsystems.
requirements.section: 1.2 System Context

requirements.text: The CTS receive instructions from trade client serve.
actions: receive instructions from trade client serve
requirements.source_sentence: The CTS receive instructions from trade client serve.
requirements.section: 1.2 System Context

requirements.text: Then the CTS produce new messages which to be sent to network message promulgating after deal with the instructions from trade client serve.
actions: deal with the instructions from trade client serve
send new messages to network message promulgating

conditions: authorization to access the information in CTS
requirements.source_sentence: Also the system manager is authorization to access the information in CTS.
requirements.section: 1.2 System Context

requirements.text: There are mainly two kinds of users.

requirements.text: The CTS provides the terminal users easy Operations that are confined to a series of mouse clicks and keyboard, which compared to other systems are really much simplified.

requirements.text: When the system crashes down, they can find the cause and fix it.
